cases.brief: Broad steady stance, waterproof leather apron over folded knit, short-bill oilskin, diagonal wood/brass valve handle and secondary belt key.
Slender body, asymmetric shoulder shawl, A-line tunic and visible bun, long-handled brass dipper in near hand and corked glass vials in tray supported by far hand.

Cliffside lantern keeper at three-quarter-right: short shoulder cloak with trailing back, lantern dangling from the raised near-hand grip, far hand pinches a leather strap; staggered feet on the same ground anchor.

Coastal field cartographer, 64×64 three-quarter-right. Narrow clear neck and fitted short coat, standing with a sighting compass in the near hand and a folded chart supported in the far hand. Avoid worker proportions and light-emitting tools.
